result_text:
I fixed the four broken default conventions in `ScopingConventions.java`, and the `codeanalyzer` module's full test suite passes offline (334 tests, 0 failures, 3 skipped). Nothing is committed.

What changed in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventions.java`:

- **Generated HTML pages (pkgdown, Doxygen, meta generator):** the path pattern was `(html|html|xhtml)`, so I changed it to `(htm|html|xhtml)`, which covers `.htm` and keeps the other two extensions.
- **.NET assembly docs XML:** `.*/[.]xml` became `.*[.]xml`, so `MyAssembly.xml` matches. The `<doc>` line check still gates it.
- **JavaScript `// Generated by …`:** `.*/[.]js` became `.*[.]js`, so `app.js` matches. The content check still gates it.
- **Gradle JavaScript scripts:** `.*[.][-]gradle[.]js` became `.*[-]gradle[.]js`, so `build-gradle.js` matches.

I also added `codeanalyzer/src/test/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventionsTest.java`. It covers the four fixes and the negative cases: a hand-written `.htm`, an `app.xml` without `<doc>`, a plain `app.js`, and `src/app.js` against the Gradle rule. All four tests pass.

I did not run the new test against the original code to confirm it fails there.
